road.en: Always look both ways before crossing the road.

help.en: I help the old man cross the road.
It feels good to help others on Road Helper Day.
help.cn: 交通小帮手日帮助别人感觉真好。

light.en: When the traffic light turns green, we can cross.
light.cn: 交通灯变绿时我们就可以过马路了。

stop.en: Always stop and look before you cross the road.
stop.cn: 过马路前一定要停下看看。

go.en: When the light is green, you can go safely.
go.cn: 绿灯亮时你可以安全通过。

wait.en: Wait for me at the door.
Please wait for the green light before you cross.
wait.cn: 请等绿灯亮了再过马路。
